body:
**Agent review** of the whole pull request, at `e45c845`: all 31 files reviewed.

1 finding(s): 1 to consider; 1 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

**Batch 1 of 2.** Part 1 looks right. The new i18n keys (dragTo, pill, destinationTag, readyCardLabel and the others) are in en.json, and every ICU select has an `other` branch. `copyPresetOf` now strips the `#revision` suffix, which fixes destination lookup for real sidecar fingerprints, and tests cover it. The minimized-widget store and the pill/error rendering logic are consistent. The ready card uses existing preload APIs only, so the Electron boundary is not widened. One finding, at consider level: ready cards are retired when the user leaves the Library even if list view or a filter kept them from being shown.

**Batch 2 of 2.** I found no problems in part 2 (stylesheets, backlog docs and i18n messages).

- **Messages:** the removed keys `backgroundCopy.hide` and `backgroundCopy.readyDragToUpload` no longer appear anywhere under `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer`, so dropping them breaks nothing. The new keys are the same in en and es.
- **Tags without a colour or wording of their own:** an `archive` copy falls back to the default grey `#2a2a30` in the stylesheet and to the `other` branch ("Archive copy") in `destinationTag`.
- **Stylesheets:** every colour variable they use is defined except `--bg-hover`. `--tone-saving` and `--accent-primary-ring` are in `assets/base.css` and already used elsewhere. `--bg-hover` comes with a fallback colour, so it still works if missing. The destination tag colours match `destination-logo.module.css`, as its comment says.
- **Docs:** the new backlog page, the index row and the update note on the background-copies page agree with the new message wording ("YouTube copy · N%", "Drag to TikTok or Reels", "FOR GITHUB / FOR CHAT").

> ℹ️ No critical issues — two rough edges inline. **Reviewed changes** Initial review of the whole PR: the Library's "Ready to upload" card, destination tags on the grid, the bottom-right export widget that minimizes to a pill, and the fix for reading a copy's destination through its encode revision. - **Ready to upload card**: each finished copy leads the grid across two columns, newest first. Grid view only, and only for copies the current filters show. It goes away when the copy is opened, its ✕ is clicked, or the user leaves `/library` (`retireReadyCards`, triggered from `useLibraryBadge`'s route watch). - **Destination tags**: copies that aren't masters carry a `DestinationTag`, taken from the runner's job or from the sidecar through `copyDestinationOf`. - **Encode-revision fix**: `copyPresetOf` compares only the part of the fingerprint before `#`. `MasterCopiesPanel` now names YouTube, GitHub and chat copies by destination. - **Export widget**: the runner's `progressHidden` / `hideExportProgress` are replaced by a session-wide minimized flag stored in `sessionStorage` (`export-widget-state.ts`). `ExportProgressPill` shows a ring, and the export cards moved to their own bottom-right stack. - **i18n**: the `backgroundCopy` copy was rewritten in `en`/`es`, adding `dragTo`, `pill`, `destinationTag` and `readyToUpload`. I checked that every route renders under `AppShell`, so the sidebar's `wasOnLibrary` ref is never reset by an unmount, and that the Library grid has a fixed three columns, so `span 2` cannot overflow.   ｜ [Fix all ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-record/464?action=fix&review_id=5720282169) ｜ [Fix 👍s ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-record/464?action=fix-approved&review_id=5720282169) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/actions/runs/41153540436/job/124395226470) ｜ Using `claude-opus-5-5` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)

It now counts the export that is running plus unseen copies. Leaving `/library` still calls `retireReadyCards`, and opening `/export*` announces ready copies the same way the Library does. - **Named Email copies:** added `email` branches to `progressTitle`, `readyTitle`, `pill`, `dragTo` and `destinationTag` in both `en` and `es`, plus a blue `.tag[data-destination="email"]`. Tests now check the progress card, the ready toast and the grid tag. The two earlier threads, on the pill's `aria-label` and on the ready card not calling `markCopySeen`, are not touched by these commits, so I left them open.   ｜ [Fix all ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-record/464?action=fix&review_id=5720339888) ｜ [Fix 👍s ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-record/464?action=fix-approved&review_id=5720339888) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/actions/runs/41154968488/job/124399635645) ｜ Using `claude-opus-5-5` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)

Only one change touches this PR's own code. - **Kept destinations for webcam takes:** `copyPresetOf` now passes the content part of the fingerprint to the base's `isWholeFingerprint`. A copy of a take with a webcam (`whole:#2560x1440-v1`, NIW2-576) still resolves to its destination. A new test in `copy-destination.test.ts` covers this. - **Merged base imports in `library-page.tsx`:** `ReconcileBanner` and `WorkspaceNotConnectedNotice` come from the base, and both are rendered. The range-diff also shows a hunk for `destinationPresetOf` in `master-copies-panel.tsx`. That change belongs to the base. In this branch the function no longer exists, because the panel goes through `copyPresetOf`. The three earlier threads are still open.
